Zoe (AE): CapitalSec asked for a compact evidence package for the POC: console admin events, API key rotation, emergency access/grant events, and proof that exported logs are immutable for 365 days. They want examples showing chain-of-custody (who exported, who signed the manifest). Can we turn this around in 48h?

Marco (SRE/SE): Yes. Plan: 1) produce a small audit export (JSONL) covering the relevant event types 2) manifest.sha256 with per-file hashes 3) PGP-signed manifest + short chain-of-custody note 4) forwarding examples (Splunk HEC, syslog+TLS, Kafka) and a short verification runbook. Hosted default retention is 90d; for 365d we recommend export->customer S3 with object-lock COMPLIANCE + customer-managed KMS.

Priya (Security): Key controls to show: console.role.grant, api_key.rotate, emergency_toggle.enable, assume_role/impersonate. We will redact emails by default but include a redaction appendix showing original vs redacted lines. We'll sign the manifest with our security PGP key and include the fingerprint in the attestation. Also include a short statement that signed manifests + object-locked storage form our chain-of-custody for the exported artifacts.

Liam (CapitalSec): Couple asks from vendor team: 1) show an example of a console role grant event 2) show api_key.rotate with pre- and post-rotation markers 3) sample PGP-signed manifest verification steps. Splunk HEC preferred. Also they want to see evidence that the export process records who initiated the export (username + job-id).

Marco (SRE/SE): We'll include an export event entry that records the operator and job id. Example lines to include in bundle:

{"ts":"2026-05-12T14:02:11Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.start","job_id":"job-8a7f3","range":"2026-05-01..2026-05-12"}

{"ts":"2026-05-12T14:05:02Z","actor":"REDACTED_USER","action":"api_key.rotate","target":"svc-billing","ip":"198.51.100.77","result":"success"}

{"ts":"2026-05-12T14:06:10Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.complete","job_id":"job-8a7f3","artifact":"bundle-20260512.zip"}

Marco (SRE/SE): Splunk HEC quick test snippet for runbook:

curl -sS https://splunk.customer.com:8088/services/collector -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' -d '{"event":{"ts":"2026-05-12T14:02:11Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.start","job_id":"job-8a7f3"}}'

Marco (SRE/SE): Kafka producer example if they prefer streaming:

# kafka-console-producer --broker-list kafka:9093 --topic redwood-audit --producer.config client.properties
{"ts":"2026-05-12T14:02:11Z","actor":"operator@redwood.com","action":"export.start","job_id":"job-8a7f3"}

Priya (Security): Redaction appendix (sample before/after) will be in README. We'll also include a short legal note about COMPLIANCE mode vs GOVERNANCE mode for object-lock, and recommend COMPLIANCE for the strongest WORM guarantee. We'll attach PGP signature info: fingerprint = 3F4B A9C2 7D12 9B8E 4E2F  0A1C  5D6A 1C9E  8B2F 9C01 (security@redwood.com).

AuditBot: export job started (1805004321) - collecting events (range 2026-05-01..2026-05-12). ETA ~90m :gear:

Zoe (AE): I'll tell CapitalSec they will get a bundle + signed manifest and verification steps. Ask them to confirm the destination S3 bucket + KMS key if they want us to perform the export directly.

Marco (SRE/SE): We'll also include a small script snippet to verify signatures and hashes in the runbook:

# verify manifest
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
# verify PGP signature
gpg --verify manifest.sha256.sig manifest.sha256

AuditBot: export complete (1805004321/final-bundle-2026-05-12.zip) - files: audit.jsonl (2.1MB), manifest.sha256, manifest.sha256.sig, README_redaction.md, attestation.pdf - https://artifacts.internal/redwood/1805004321/final-bundle-2026-05-12.zip

Liam (CapitalSec): Received. We'll run the verification and revert with any follow-ups. Thanks for including the operator/job-id fields.

Zoe (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll book a short verification call with CapitalSec in case they want us to walk through the signature verification live.
